correctness.rationale: Two exhaustive methods construct the same 7,627-face augmented complex. The complete 3,768-pair matching has 28,836 directed Hasse incidences and is globally acyclic, with exactly 91 critical three-cells. The matched empty face yields a reduced discrete-Morse CW model with 91 three-cells and no other positive-dimensional cells, so the integral homotopy type is a 91-fold three-sphere wedge. The full 144 automorphisms are independently enumerated, all signed cellular traces computed, and their irreducible multiplicities and dimension 4 invariant subspace verified.

value.rationale: The Nauru graph is a canonical highly symmetric cubic bipartite incidence/arrangement graph. Its exact integral wedge-of-spheres homotopy type and complete full-automorphism rational character provide a natural finite equivariant classification, including four group-invariant degree-three classes not recoverable from general nonvanishing or Leray theory. No generalized high-girth family is claimed.
